direction.camera: Guide attention with deep black; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: a narrow luminous object sits inside a large dark field; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with gold edge; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with formal symmetry.
direction.lighting: thin warm rim; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: obsidian and brushed gold; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around slow dissolve; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use deep black,gold edge,jewel silence,wide tracking,slow dissolve,formal symmetry as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
